Installation:
->Within your female Harvey-oriented Content Patcher mod of choice, replace the appropriate Spritesheets/Portraits with the corresponding normal portrait/overworld sprites provided.
->Drag and drop the contents of the [CP] Female bachelors Beach folder into the folder of the same name for RedK1rby's Female Bachelors Beach Sprites mod.
